limitations: No claim about global interior-maximizer uniqueness away from the boundary, arbitrary signed jumps, or joint optimization of quadratic variance proxy and pole; the b=1 endpoint is prior art. Independent validation is not performed.
scientific_integrity: The coefficientwise majorization and analytic bifurcation prove the stated family-specific threshold; finite computations supplement the proof. Published equal-amplitude and general transform results are expressly credited.
title: A sharp unequal-jump sub-gamma phase surface and quadratic crossover
